item.title: Connecting to the Polymarket API in R
item.description: Hello, I’ve looked online and I don’t see a good answer, but has anyone connected to the polymarket API and downloaded historic and/or live data into RStudio? I’ve seen options for python but not R. Interested in doing some personal research and would like to know if anyone has any tips, links, or packages that might be helpful in achieving this goal.
